issuer: the Greenland Police (Grønlands Politi), at the local police station
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Greenland Police's own site. Greenland issues its own licence (categories B, C and D), applied for or renewed at the local police station: category B is had from 18, after lessons with an approved instructor and a theory and a driving test. It is valid from the driving test until the holder turns 70 (held as no term in years, ending at 70); from 70 it is renewed for shorter periods on a doctor's assessment (four years at 70, three at 71, two from 72 to 79, every year from 80), which isn't held. No fee is stated, so it is null. Someone moving to Greenland with a valid Danish licence may keep using it and needn't exchange it; that is recognition, not an exchange, and no exchange list is held.

sources.title: Grønlands Politi, Ansøg om kørekort
sources.said: Ansøg om eller forny dit kørekort på din lokale politistation. ... Det grønlandske kørekort er opdelt i følgende kategorier: Kategori B - almindelig bil ... Være 18 år eller derover ... Kørekortet er gyldigt fra, at du har bestået din køreprøve til, at du fylder 70 år. ... Flytter du til Grønland og har et gyldigt dansk kørekort, kan du fortsat bruge det i Grønland.
